audited_by: cymek principal agent (fresh handoff, no inherited claims)
method: Every classification below was derived by reading the executable source and running the code, not from commit messages, README claims, or prior agent prose.

tokenizer_artifact.provenance: esoes-e1-local-corpus-manifest/v1 with per-file sha256; trainer config receipt bound in result.json

verification_evidence.ci_on_cymek_head: none (e0-research.yml triggers on esoes pushes and PRs only)

MODEL.evidence: v5_model.core.initialize builds the exact 250,216,960-parameter V5-A center with GQA, RoPE, affine QK norm, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, tied embeddings, and receipt assertions. It is imported by tests only; the P35 CUDA canary instead uses e2_architecture.block_benchmark._build_model (the legacy 'middle' arm), so production training has never touched the real V5 core.

TOKENIZER.evidence: A contract-conformant, provenance-bound 24,576-entry byte-BPE artifact exists (see verification_evidence). v5_tokenizer.adapter.FrozenTokenizer is a validated facade over an injected backend. No production path loads the artifact; no TokenizerIdentity receipt binds it into v5_training or v5_data.

RAW_DATA.evidence: e1 corpus manifest binds real repository source files with sha256 per file, but it is a tokenizer-tournament development corpus, not the 5B-token training corpus. No canonical training-corpus artifact exists in-repo.

MANIFEST.evidence: v5_contracts.data_spec defines DataManifest/PackManifest receipts, but no executable builder produces a training data manifest from raw sources.

DEDUP.evidence: v5_data.split.exact_clusters is a real deterministic primitive; no pipeline applies it to real documents.

CONTAMINATION.evidence: v5_data.split.scan_contamination is real (8-gram scan, fail-closed policy documented); no pipeline runs it against held-out evals.

SPLIT.evidence: v5_data.split.assign_split is a real deterministic cluster-hash split over TRAIN/DEV/SEALED/FRESH; unused by any pipeline.

TOKENIZATION.evidence: FrozenTokenizer facade + real artifact both exist; the two have never been bound together and executed.

PACK.evidence: v5_data.pack.build_shards implements bucket+pad with ONE document segment per sequence (buckets 512/1024/2048/4096). The frozen training spec (training_spec.py packing block: cross_segment_attention=false, position reset per segment) implies multi-segment sequences are in scope; true multi-document packing with segment IDs is NOT implemented. The model side already supports block-diagonal packed attention via v5_model.core.packed_layout; no data producer emits segment IDs.

MIXTURE.evidence: v5_data.mixture implements exact largest-remainder allocation for 65/20/15 over 5B tokens plus nine cognition families; no stream enforces allocation at consumption time.

SAMPLER.evidence: v5_data.pack.sampler_order and v5_data.cursor.advance are real deterministic primitives over shards; unused by any production loop.

CURSOR.evidence: CursorState is bound into TrainingState and certified by certify_update (must advance every update). The pack-level cursor primitives exist; connection to real shards is missing because the shards do not exist.

BATCH.evidence: No module converts packed shards + cursor into (input, target, segment, loss-mask) tensors. The P35 canary fabricates random token tensors directly.

OBJECTIVE.evidence: v5_objectives.causal_lm exists with the challenger query-swap fail-closed; canaries use raw F.cross_entropy instead of the canonical objective module.

OPTIMIZER.evidence: v5_training.optimizer.build_adamw_optimizer implements spec AdamW (beta1 0.9, beta2 0.95, eps 1e-8, wd 0.1, ndim>=2 decay, ndim<2 no decay, tied embedding single ownership) with ownership validation; used by both canaries.

SCHEDULE.evidence: v5_training.schedule.lr_at implements the token-indexed WSD schedule; canaries instead use torch LambdaLR constant 1.0. No trainer consumes lr_at.

BACKWARD.evidence: Real torch autograd runs inside torch_canary/_one_update on the legacy e2 model with random tokens; no production backend owns it.

GRADIENT_REDUCTION.evidence: v5_training.distributed defines rank checkpoint metadata; no all-reduce implementation.

GRADIENT_CLIP.evidence: clip_grad_norm_(1.0) runs inside the legacy canary; certification checks post-clip norm <= 1.0 + 1e-9 from a self-reported float.

UPDATE.evidence: Real AdamW.step() executes in canaries, but certification (certify_update) verifies only state-machine semantics from BackendReport self-reports: nothing proves parameter SHA changed, moments mutated, or optimizer owns live parameters. Historical core-vnext failure mode (metadata advances, weights do not) is currently mechanically undetectable.

CHECKPOINT.evidence: CheckpointStore is content-addressed, fsync-backed, parent-fenced, and used by both canaries. Component payloads are caller-supplied; no production builder serializes model/optimizer.

RESUME.evidence: Legacy canary proves hash-equal continuation on the e2 model; no production-path resume exists.

RNG.evidence: rng.bin payload saved/restored and hash-bound in state + checkpoints of both canaries.

DISTRIBUTED.evidence: Metadata schema only; no collective or replicated execution.

TPU_XLA.evidence: No XLA path. The core-vnext lesson (stale optimizer owning dead parameters after device movement) has no mechanical detection in the current production code.

EVALUATION.evidence: ModelAdapter accepts injected callables; no checkpoint-backed V5 adapter exists. metrics.py (Wilson LCB etc.) is real and tested.

PROMOTION.evidence: v5_promotion.gates.evaluate_gates has vacuous-truth bugs: sensitivity_flip and invariance_stable compute all(...) over possibly-empty family filters, so missing evidence yields PASS. Gates state_ood/two_hop use point estimates per the frozen spec, but the module docstring claims Wilson bounds everywhere; docstring and frozen spec disagree with code. decide() itself is fail-closed.

REMOTE_EXECUTION.evidence: v5_remote binds job/result identities and collects receipts; no submit/execute/monitor backend. Launch receipt correctly does not claim remote readiness.

CI.evidence: .github/workflows/e0-research.yml runs on esoes push/PR only; no exact-head checks exist on cymek.

highest_leverage_broken_link: PRODUCTION_TRAINING_BACKEND: v5_training.trainer owns no tensors and requires a caller-supplied backend_step; nothing implements the real REAL PACKED BATCH -> V5 CORE -> CE -> BACKWARD -> CLIP -> ADAMW -> LR SCHEDULE -> PARAMETER MUTATION -> CHECKPOINT chain. Building it unlocks update certification, the stale-optimizer attack, exact resume through one path, and converging both canaries onto production.
launch_criteria_frozen_reference: v5_contracts.launch_readiness gates E1-E6 plus the 20 launch gates in the handoff; main_training_authorized remains false; missing external identities are enumerated in artifacts/v5/launch_readiness.json and are not claimable by code.

negative_evidence_preserved.legacy_p35_canary: torch_canary.py is retained as comparison evidence; its synthetic-data receipts certify wiring only.
negative_evidence_preserved.bucket_pad_packer: build_shards retained; it documents the pre-packing design and remains valid for the 4096 full-context bucket.
